articles.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost
articles.snippet: Some smaller hedge funds with weaker security controls may have lost funds in the targeted attack, sources said.

articles.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
articles.snippet: Although the ECB holds no formal licensing authority under MiCA, high-level intervention led Greece to stall an application that regulators had previously deemed complete, the Journal said.

articles.title: Layer-2 and DeFi tokens lead broad crypto advance as post-Fed hike nerves fade
articles.snippet: Starknet and arbitrum gained more than 17% while the 10-year Treasury yield slipped back below 5%, with 98 of CoinDesk 100 constituents advancing.

articles.title: Bitcoin weathers September storm as rate hikes and Clarity act setback test bulls
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is down just 1.5% in its historically weakest month and remains on track for its first quarterly gain in a year, despite rising rates, surging oil and a stronger dollar.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs over $80,000 as crypto shakes off Clarity failure and higher interest rates
articles.snippet: Another central bank hiked rates overnight, this time the Bank of Japan. The move failed to halt the slide in the yen.
